name: const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> Pin < Ptr >
rule: Unless `Ptr::Target` implements `Unpin`, the caller must ensure that the storage of the data pointed to by `pointer` is not invalidated until the data is dropped; for `Pin<&'a mut T>`, this obligation continues after `'a` ends or the `Pin` is dropped if the value has not yet been dropped.
api: impl < Ptr : Deref > core::pin::Pin < Ptr > { const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> core::pin::Pin < Ptr > }
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: `Unpin`, opaque `Ptr` pointee storage, and validity until drop are not modeled.
